C0854.title: RaaS Becomes Dominant Framework for Ransomware Attacks
C0854.summary: In May 2025, FreeBuf reported that Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) has emerged as the primary business model in cybercrime. RaaS operators provide affiliates with customizable ransomware, infrastructure, and payment processing, taking a 20%–30% cut of ransom proceeds.
